name: Seek Redemption!

meta.start: Sentinel Kyra StarsongSyral BladeleafSentinel Shayla Nightbreeze

summary: In Dolanaar, you face the Council of the Forest's demand for atonement. Adventurers were duped into doing Zenn Foulhoof's dirty work, and now the council sends you to trick the satyr into eating corrupted fel cones.

sections.title: A Fool's Errand Undone
sections.body: Just outside Dolanaar, solitary satyr Zenn Foulhoof uses deceit to make passersby do his bidding. Adventurers who unwittingly slaughtered nightsabers, strigid owls, and webwood spiders to satisfy his twisted appetites draw the Council of the Forest's sharp disapproval. The council will not accept harm to nature, especially from its own allies.

sections.title: The Price of Atonement
sections.body: Syral Bladeleaf, Sentinel Kyra Starsong, or Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze warns you that you must make amends to remain welcome in Teldrassil. Dolanaar's guardians tell you to turn Foulhoof's wicked gluttony against him instead of facing him with steel. Gather the billowing, corrupted fel cones from the forest floor, then offer the unsuspecting satyr a taste of his own foul medicine.

sections.title: A Croaking Retribution
sections.body: You hand Zenn Foulhoof the noxious cones, posing as a loyal errand-runner with a sweet snack. Unaware of the druidic snare, the satyr eagerly devours them and is promptly changed into a helpless frog, humbled before the wilderness he sought to taint.

faq.q: Why is the Council of the Forest angry with me?
faq.answer: You followed Zenn Foulhoof's earlier bidding and unwittingly slaughtered nightsabers, strigid owls, and spiders. The Council of the Forest sees that needless killing as a defilement of Teldrassil and demands atonement.

faq.q: Who can give me this quest?
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf outside the northern dwelling, Sentinel Kyra Starsong inside the inn, or Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze along the western road can offer it after you finish helping Foulhoof.
Fel cones are corrupted pine seeds from the twisted branches around Teldrassil. Green vapors billow from their husks, and druids turn their foul magic against unsuspecting miscreants.

faq.q: Why offer the fel cones to Zenn Foulhoof?
faq.answer: The Council expects you to teach Foulhoof a lesson. He takes the corrupted cones for a harmless snack from someone who once did his bidding.

faq.q: Why is there a satyr living so close to Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Zenn Foulhoof keeps to a hollowed clearing just outside Dolanaar and hides his malice behind false pleasantries. Satyrs across Kalimdor are ancient servants of the Burning Legion, and his presence shows how far corruption reaches into the young World Tree.

faq.q: Can you skip or abandon this quest without ruining your standing?
faq.answer: Yes. The Council of the Forest scolds you for helping Foulhoof, but leaving this unfinished does not harm your standing or reputation with the night elves of Darnassus.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, aiding a satyr brings deep humiliation. The Burning Legion warped satyrs into ancient enemies during the War of the Ancients, so making amends before the Council of the Forest matters to cultural honor.
As a druid, you hold Teldrassil's balance sacred. Hunting predators and scavengers for a demon-tainted outcast violates the Cenarion circle's tenets of guardianship.
